# Harborline hub

This repository is the hub: every session starts here.

## What belongs where

- A fact true of one repository lives in that repository.

## Where work is filed

- File an item in the hub's tracker only when no single repository owns it.

## Dispatching work

- Work in a target repository through a worktree of it.

## Working material

- Scratch files go in `.work/`, ignored, in the hub's main checkout only.
